\section[\texorpdfstring{\fa{استعفا} \fa{دادن} (este'fâ dâdan)}{استعفا دادن (este'fâ dâdan)}]{\fa{استعفا} \fa{دادن} (este'fâ dâdan) — to resign}

\label{lesson:FA-C379-estefa-dadan}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Persian for a bonus, then the Persian for benefits.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \fa{استعفا} \fa{دادن}}
\textbf{\fa{استعفا} \fa{دادن}} (\emph{este'fâ dâdan}) — \textquotedblleft{}to resign\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\fa{مدیر} \fa{شرکت} \fa{دیروز} \fa{استعفا} \fa{داد}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{modir-e sherkat diruz este'fâ dâd.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
The company director resigned yesterday.
\end{quote}

\emph{Este'fâ} \textquotedblleft{}resignation\textquotedblright{} + \emph{dâdan} (stem \emph{deh-}). \emph{Az kâr este'fâ dâdan} — to resign from a job.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\fa{استعفا}} is usually traced to Arabic \emph{isti'fā'} \textquotedblleft{}asking to be excused, asking to be let off\textquotedblright{}; with \emph{dâdan} \textquotedblleft{}to give\textquotedblright{} you hand in your resignation.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling, explaining and describing at B1.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{este'fâ dâdan}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{este'fâ dâdan}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} a sentence of your own with \emph{este'fâ dâdan}
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Persian for a bonus, then the Persian for benefits, then say \emph{este'fâ dâdan} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \fa{استعفا} \fa{دادن} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}To resign\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.

\section[\texorpdfstring{\fa{اخراج} \fa{کردن} (ekhrâj kardan)}{اخراج کردن (ekhrâj kardan)}]{\fa{اخراج} \fa{کردن} (ekhrâj kardan) — to dismiss, to fire}

\label{lesson:FA-C379-ekhraj-kardan}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Persian for benefits, then the Persian for to resign.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \fa{اخراج} \fa{کردن}}
\textbf{\fa{اخراج} \fa{کردن}} (\emph{ekhrâj kardan}) — \textquotedblleft{}to dismiss, to fire\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\fa{شرکت} \fa{ده} \fa{کارمند} \fa{را} \fa{اخراج} \fa{کرد}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{sherkat dah kârmand râ ekhrâj kard.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
The company dismissed ten employees.
\end{quote}

Also to expel a pupil. The person takes \emph{râ}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\fa{اخراج}} is usually traced to Arabic \emph{ikhrāj} \textquotedblleft{}putting out, sending out\textquotedblright{}, from the same Arabic family as Persian \emph{khârej} \textquotedblleft{}outside\textquotedblright{}.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling, explaining and describing at B1.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{ekhrâj kardan}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{ekhrâj kardan}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} a sentence of your own with \emph{ekhrâj kardan}
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Persian for benefits, then the Persian for to resign, then say \emph{ekhrâj kardan} again
\end{itemize}

\section[\texorpdfstring{\fa{اخراج} \fa{شدن} (ekhrâj shodan)}{اخراج شدن (ekhrâj shodan)}]{\fa{اخراج} \fa{شدن} (ekhrâj shodan) — to be dismissed, to be fired}

\label{lesson:FA-C379-ekhraj-shodan}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Persian for to resign, then the Persian for to dismiss.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \fa{اخراج} \fa{شدن}}
\textbf{\fa{اخراج} \fa{شدن}} (\emph{ekhrâj shodan}) — \textquotedblleft{}to be dismissed, to be fired\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\fa{او} \fa{به} \fa{خاطر} \fa{دیر} \fa{آمدن} \fa{اخراج} \fa{شد}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{u be khâter-e dir âmadan ekhrâj shod.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
He was fired for coming late.
\end{quote}

The passive of \emph{ekhrâj kardan}, with \emph{shodan} (stem \emph{shav-}).

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\fa{اخراج} \fa{شدن}} joins \emph{ekhrâj}, usually traced to Arabic \emph{ikhrāj} \textquotedblleft{}putting out\textquotedblright{}, to the inherited Persian verb \emph{shodan} \textquotedblleft{}to become\textquotedblright{}.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling, explaining and describing at B1.
\end{grammarlens}

  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{ekhrâj shodan}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} a sentence of your own with \emph{ekhrâj shodan}
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Persian for to resign, then the Persian for to dismiss, then say \emph{ekhrâj shodan} again
\end{itemize}

\section[\texorpdfstring{\fa{بیکاری} (bikâri)}{بیکاری (bikâri)}]{\fa{بیکاری} (bikâri) — unemployment}

\label{lesson:FA-C379-bikari}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Persian for to dismiss, then the Persian for to be dismissed.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \fa{بیکاری}}
\textbf{\fa{بیکاری}} (\emph{bikâri}) — \textquotedblleft{}unemployment\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\fa{بیکاری} \fa{بین} \fa{جوانها} \fa{زیاد} \fa{است}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{bikâri beyn-e javânhâ ziyâd ast.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
Unemployment is high among young people.
\end{quote}

From \emph{bikâr} \textquotedblleft{}unemployed\textquotedblright{}: \emph{bi-} \textquotedblleft{}without\textquotedblright{} + \emph{kâr} \textquotedblleft{}work\textquotedblright{} + \emph{-i}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\fa{بیکاری}} is native Persian, built from \emph{bi-} \textquotedblleft{}without\textquotedblright{} + \emph{kâr} \textquotedblleft{}work\textquotedblright{} (EtymDB traces it to Middle Persian) + the noun suffix \emph{-i}.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling, explaining and describing at B1.
\end{grammarlens}

  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Persian for to dismiss, then the Persian for to be dismissed, then say \emph{bikâri} again

\section[\texorpdfstring{\fa{بازنشستگی} (bâzneshastegi)}{بازنشستگی (bâzneshastegi)}]{\fa{بازنشستگی} (bâzneshastegi) — retirement}

\label{lesson:FA-C379-bazneshastegi}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Persian for to be dismissed, then the Persian for unemployment.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \fa{بازنشستگی}}
\textbf{\fa{بازنشستگی}} (\emph{bâzneshastegi}) — \textquotedblleft{}retirement\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\fa{پدربزرگم} \fa{بعد} \fa{از} \fa{بازنشستگی} \fa{بیشتر} \fa{کتاب} \fa{میخواند}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{pedarbozorgam ba'd az bâzneshastegi bishtar ketâb mikhânad.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
Since he retired, my grandfather reads more.
\end{quote}

From \emph{bâzneshaste} \textquotedblleft{}retired\textquotedblright{}: \emph{bâz} \textquotedblleft{}back\textquotedblright{} + \emph{neshaste} \textquotedblleft{}seated\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\fa{بازنشستگی}} is native Persian, built from \emph{bâz} \textquotedblleft{}back\textquotedblright{} + \emph{neshaste}, the participle of \emph{neshastan} \textquotedblleft{}to sit\textquotedblright{}, + \emph{-gi}. A retired person has sat back down.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling, explaining and describing at B1.
\end{grammarlens}

  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Persian for to be dismissed, then the Persian for unemployment, then say \emph{bâzneshastegi} again
\end{itemize}
